scope: Family semantics, immutable local delivery publication and CLI/MCP integration; independent delivery re-review after reproduced fixes.

findings.problem: A family report candidate could omit xs and bypass delivery validation.
findings.resolution: Require xs for every family candidate; ordinary legacy X unchanged.

findings.problem: A family report plan could carry a raster contract that the snapshot report does not have.
findings.resolution: Family report plans and candidates are explicitly non-raster and cannot carry ct.

findings.problem: Generic snapshot publication could also activate the delivery task.
findings.resolution: New snapshot publication adds exactly its candidate, with every existing record unchanged.

findings.problem: A rooted report accepted a manifest directory redirected elsewhere inside the project.
findings.resolution: Reject lexical/resolved manifest path differences; a real Windows junction regression passes.

independent_final_review.scope: 21 delivery checks plus the two family structural regressions.

boundaries: Unrooted validation cannot inspect frozen manifest bindings or copied bytes; required rooted family reports and publication do.
Synthetic receipts, copied local files and scripted behavior do not establish artistic continuity or engine acceptance.
